verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for an identity, KYC and fraud platform that stores customer PII, so the story applies. The evidence pack never documents configurable retention periods, deletion APIs or data-erasure workflows. It only notes that Alloy stores submitted event data and keeps entities in a single shared data store, which says nothing about user control over retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
